hypothesis.statement: On real Fantasia RR intervals, the newly-authored trimmedMean reproduces BOTH scipy.stats.trim_mean AND base R mean(x, trim) BIT-FOR-BIT; and because the RR distribution is right-skewed, the plain mean exceeds the trimmed mean, which exceeds the median (mean > trimmed > median).

analysis_plan.dataset: Fantasia database (PhysioNet), subject f1y01 (young healthy adult), first 5-minute RR window (392 intervals, ms)

decision.threshold: descriptive: trimmedMean equals scipy.stats.trim_mean AND base R mean(x, trim) to machine precision (max |diff| < 1e-9 vs each)
